channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says he has no regrets about starting the Iran war as U.S. dials up economic pressure
item.description: Speaking to Fox News presenter Laura Ingraham, Trump said that he would have attacked Iran despite the impact on the midterm elections.

item.title: Bessent says 'a large bank' will be sanctioned on Monday as part of Iran strategy
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that a large bank would be sanctioned next week.

item.title: Chinese AI labs secretly used millions of Claude exchanges to train their models, Anthropic says
item.description: Anthropic said it detected unauthorized efforts by China-based AI labs including Alibaba and Moonshot AI to use its Claude models to help improve their own AI systems.

item.title: Stock futures are little changed as key consumer inflation report looms ahead: Live updates
item.description: The three major averages are heading for a losing week as higher oil prices and a surge in Treasury yields weigh on stocks.

item.title: Modi and Xi are set to meet at BRICS with trade and border issues in spotlight
item.description: A meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi would be the clearest test yet of the tentative post-2020 reset between Asia’s two largest economies.

item.title: Investors gave up on this AI play, but charts suggest it's worth a look, Jay Woods says
item.description: This stock grabbed traders attention in early 2026 as momentum drove shares up over 75%. But the sentiment was too euphoric.

item.title: Chinese Nvidia rival Enflame soars 206% on stock market debut as AI demand stays hot
item.description: Chinese AI chipmaker Enflame, an Nvidia rival and one of China's "four little dragons," made its Shanghai market debut.

item.title: California enacts new curbs on social media for children
item.description: California enacted laws restricting addictive social media features for under-16s and banning AI companion chatbots in toys.

item.title: Hassett kept up to $5 million Coinbase stake as Trump reshaped crypto policy
item.description: Trump economic advisor Kevin Hassett owned as much as $5 million in Coinbase while serving as the White House's top economic advisor, his disclosure shows.

item.title: China-Philippines tensions simmer after Beijing rebukes Manila over Seoul clash
item.description: China and the Philippines have been locked in years of tension over their competing claims in the South China Sea, with friction intensifying in recent months.

item.title: 'Extinction' warnings ramp up as more OpenAI, Anthropic researchers join calls for an AI slowdown
item.description: There is growing concern globally about the capability of AI, following numerous cyberattacks and security incidents in recent months by rogue models

item.title: Bond sell-off, stock boom: Why rebalancing is a good strategy right now
item.description: With stocks near all-time highs and bonds selling off, it's likely a good time for investors to consider rebalancing to their target risk, advisors said.

item.title: The iPhone Duo enters China’s crowded foldable market — and faces a price test
item.description: Chinese netizens focused on the price of Apple’s iPhone Duo, as cheaper Xiaomi and Huawei foldables raise value comparisons and muddle the foldable's reception.

item.title: Oracle's stock edges up on earnings beat as cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubles
item.description: Oracle's results for the quarter came in stronger than expected, as did its revenue backlog.

item.title: China's global hunt for tax revenue may be just getting started
item.description: Beijing's recent push to tax offshore wealth may be only the opening phase of a broader campaign that could eventually reach overseas properties, inheritances.

item.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan says 'do nothing' about distillation as AI giants accuse China of copying their tech
item.description: At Y Combinator’s annual Demo Day, CEO Garry Tan explained why he's less concerned about frontier AI model distillation and the existential risk of AI.

item.title: Josh Brown says Apple's stock chart just gave you a classic 'tell.' What it means
item.description: Josh and Sean review two stock pullbacks they believe are refreshers rather than rally-enders for both names.

item.title: Trump's $1 trillion-plus 'dividend' plan meets immediate bipartisan pushback
item.description: Such a payout could cost more than $1 trillion and is likely to face legal obstacles.

item.title: Investors seek hedges as midterms and geopolitical risks threaten market calm
item.description: Investors are starting to seek more protection against stock market swings as a historically volatile period for markets approaches.

item.title: Jim Cramer says this is the key force driving stocks right now
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the 30-year Treasury yield is a key force driving stocks as it climbs to roughly 5.3%.

item.description: Analysts at Piper called Broadcom the "ASIC compute king" in a new note to clients.

item.title: Kimmel says interview with Senate candidate Talarico won't air on ABC amid FCC threats

item.title: Elon Musk's Boring Co. turns to Middle East for expansion in reaching $23 billion valuation
item.description: The Boring Co.'s latest $3 billion financing round was led by the United Arab Emirates.

item.title: OpenAI targets work of Wall Street junior bankers with new ChatGPT for Financial Services

item.title: Trump announces $500 Obamacare refunds for nearly 1 million people — here's who qualifies
item.description: Health policy experts said the refunds are unlikely to defray steep premium increases following the lapse of enhanced ACA subsidies.

item.title: Anthropic says it blocked misuse of its AI that could have supported biological weapons
